package migrations

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestDiscoverSortsAndHashesForwardSQLFiles(t *testing.T) {
	directory := t.TempDir()
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "002_second.sql"), []byte("SELECT 2;\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "001_first.sql"), []byte("SELECT 1;\n"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(directory, "README.md"), []byte("ignored"), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	migrations, err := Discover(directory)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Discover returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if len(migrations) != 2 || migrations[0].Filename != "001_first.sql" || migrations[1].Filename != "002_second.sql" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected migrations: %#v", migrations)
	}
	if migrations[0].SHA256 == migrations[1].SHA256 || len(migrations[0].SHA256) != 64 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected checksums: %#v", migrations)
	}
}

func TestValidateHistoryRejectsChecksumAndOrderingProblems(t *testing.T) {
	migrations := []Migration{
		{Filename: "001_first.sql", SHA256: "first"},
		{Filename: "002_second.sql", SHA256: "second"},
	}
	if err := validateHistory(migrations, map[string]string{"001_first.sql": "changed"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected checksum mismatch")
	}
	if err := validateHistory(migrations, map[string]string{"002_second.sql": "second"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected migration gap")
	}
	if err := validateHistory(migrations, map[string]string{"003_unknown.sql": "unknown"}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unknown migration rejection")
	}
}

func TestNormalizeOuterTransactionKeepsMigrationInsideRunnerTransaction(t *testing.T) {
	input := `-- migration comment
BEGIN;
CREATE FUNCTION sample() RETURNS void AS $$
BEGIN
    PERFORM 1;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
COMMIT;
`
	want := `CREATE FUNCTION sample() RETURNS void AS $$
BEGIN
    PERFORM 1;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;`
	got, err := normalizeOuterTransaction(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalizeOuterTransaction returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("normalized SQL = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}

func TestNormalizeOuterTransactionRejectsIncompletePair(t *testing.T) {
	for _, sql := range []string{
		"BEGIN; CREATE TABLE sample (id int);",
		"CREATE TABLE sample (id int); COMMIT;",
	} {
		if _, err := normalizeOuterTransaction(sql); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("normalizeOuterTransaction(%q) should reject an incomplete pair", sql)
		}
	}
}

func TestNormalizeOuterTransactionLeavesUnwrappedMigrationAlone(t *testing.T) {
	input := "-- no explicit outer transaction\nCREATE TABLE sample (id int);\n"
	got, err := normalizeOuterTransaction(input)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("normalizeOuterTransaction returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if want := "-- no explicit outer transaction\nCREATE TABLE sample (id int);"; got != want {
		t.Fatalf("normalized SQL = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
